decisions.reason: The mobile slow-speed shredder sits in the firm's core competence and is easy to service and refine, though the new 2024 slow-speed shredder line could eventually replace it.

As the multi-model flagship modular plant line, it builds on the firm's accumulated know-how and research cooperation, and the lessons from withdrawing Product A strengthen the firm's ability to develop it.
The mobile trommel screen is close to the established offer and fits the firm's service and telematics network, so its early results are easy to interpret and improve on.
The new slow-speed shredder line extends the firm's deepest shredding competence across several models and has its own page, making it a natural product to absorb and develop further.
The spiral shaft screens build on the firm's screening know-how and are presented as a multi-model line, so in-house R&D can assimilate market feedback and refine them.
